messages:
Maya Chen: Dropping a follow-up from today's review for the batch vectors preview + rerank export. New frames are at https://figma.redwood/vec-export-ux2. Main asks: concise export copy, visible selection count behavior on mobile, keyboard reorder hints, and screen reader announcements.

Sam O'Neill: First pass: toolbar gets crowded after 6 selections on tablet. Instead of pushing primary actions into overflow, I'd prefer a stacked compact toolbar that keeps Reorder + Export visible and moves secondary items into kebab. Keeps muscle memory intact.

Priya Patel: Copy thoughts: visual CTA stays `Export` + counter chip `• 4 selected`. For SR: include an sr-only node that reads `Export 4 vectors`. That keeps telemetry-stable labels while giving context to assistive tech.

Alina Kho: A11y: implement `role=list`/`listitem` for the preview rows and roving tabindex. Announce selection changes with a polite live region: "4 vectors selected". When rerank weights change and scores refresh, announce "Relevance scores refreshed". Use clear-then-write to avoid duplicated reads.

Devon Park: Keyboard reorder: allow `Ctrl/Cmd + Alt + Arrow` to nudge a focused row up/down (avoid colliding with browser shortcuts). Announce new position: "Moved to position 3" in the live region. Hint shown once: `Tip: use Ctrl+Alt+Up/Down to reorder when focused`.

a11y-bot: Checklist: 1) roving tabindex example included in PR; 2) live region for selection + rerank updates; 3) export CTA has sr-only full label; 4) stacked toolbar spec for touch with min target 44px; 5) focus ring visible for rows and chips; 6) export modal traps focus and describes CSV columns.

Maya Chen: Nice. A couple extra UX constraints: if user toggles column mapping modal, freeze selection changes in the background to avoid surprises. Show a small badge `Pending selection changes` if someone else updates the dataset concurrently. For large exports (>=2k rows) show background processing note and disable repeated confirms.

Priya Patel: Suggested export modal header text when launching from selection: `Export 4 vectors as CSV`. Small blurb: `Includes id, text, and relevance_score. Customize columns below.` For async case: `This export will be processed in the background; we'll email you a download link.`

Alina Kho: Also ensure header cells have descriptive `aria-label`s e.g., `Relevance score, higher values indicate stronger match` so screen readers get context when swiping columns.

Sam O'Neill: Action items: @Alina add code snippet for live region + roving tabindex; @Devon add keyboard reorder hint and announce flow; @Priya finalize the two modal header variants and sr-only strings; I'll mock stacked toolbar frames for small/medium breakpoints. I'll merge updates into the Figma file by Friday.

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone, leaving this open for any last comments. If blocking, DM me. :sparkles:
